sourceNotes: Colossus retains140baseHP/two slams/cleave; Necromancy does not satisfy Wizard Conjuration creationHP. Full new profile and actual Companion05 offense/birth/ending remain required.

Black Reaping keeps6d8 cone and aggregate heal from expressly selected actual final damage branches; enumerate temporary/normalHP loss, no overkill or double-counted parent/child, resolve returned harm before caster healing.
Chain of the Grave preserves3rounds and both teleport and magical movement prevention; exact Transport6 participants/transactions and named return exceptions stay distinct.
Finger of Death keeps7d8+30 and actual eligible humanoid committed-death gate before one body claim/zombie; full new zombie profile and custody cannot inherit unacquired class abilities.
Plague Wind retains30ftcone8d6 plus separately complete finite disease; current Contagion treatment/lifecycle is source-local, and Petrified oral dosing stays unavailable.
Metal to Glass DEX avoids dropping, not conversion. Whole material/component admission, real fragile profile, support and lasting-versus-reversible choice require complete lineage.

Titanic Grip doubles size and assigns fixedSTR22, not a floor, with expressly scoped2d6 attack bonus. Flash Freeze keeps6d10cold and exactly1round Restrained without inferred suffocation, paralysis or extra damage.
Transmute Being requires all3 Elemental/Beast/Ooze forms and separate cases, actual120ft/60sec and same identity/currentHP/equipment; source-specific anatomy/attack ownership and acquisition persist.

Regenerate is4d8+15ordinary healing plus explicit living-limb restoration; anatomy and HP-gain gates differ, with real injury/part provenance and no implicit Wound cure, resurrection, detached-part deletion or duplicate harvest.
